La retraite internationale de Romelu Lukaku (33 ans), meilleur buteur de l'histoire en sélection belge (94 pions en 135 sélections), laisse un grand vide chez les Diables Rouges. Comme l'a souligné hier La Dernière Heure Les Sports +, les candidats ne manquent pas mais le Diablotin Lucas Stassin part de loin. Extraits.

"Charles De Ketelaere a pris le relais, dans un autre style mais sans être remis en question. Il est le titulaire incontesté en pointe, même s'il joue à une autre position à l'Atalanta. Il sera d'ailleurs intéressant de voir s'il osera prendre le n°9 au prochain rassemblement. Qui pour doubler CDK dorénavant ? Le casting est large et étonnamment ouvert.

Loïs Openda peut y penser, lui qui retrouvait peu à peu ses sensations à Lyon avant de se blesser et de manquer ce rassemblement. Mais parviendra-t-il enfin à éclore en équipe nationale alors qu'il fêtera bientôt son 27e anniversaire ? Il n'a inscrit que trois buts chez les Diables jusqu'à présent.

Hugo Cuypers, le Belge le plus prolifique ces derniers mois, peut espérer monter en grade après avoir fêté sa première sélection. Mais lui aura 30 ans au prochain rassemblement. Il ne sera pas une solution à long terme et devra aussi prouver qu'il peut avoir le niveau en évoluant dans le championnat mexicain.

L'avant-centre le plus prometteur en Belgique, c'est probablement Matias Fernandez-Pardo (21 ans), mais avec un tout autre profil que Lukaku et De Ketelaere. Acheté 60 M€ par Newcastle cet été, il possède une vitesse et une puissance de jambes assez phénoménales. Le tout avec un vrai sens du but.

Industry observers note that le sélectionneur a aussi une autre option, très différente : le faux 9. Deux joueurs sont capables de prendre ce rôle, que CDK peut parfois avoir selon le moment du match. On pense à Leandro Trossard, qui avait par moments dépanné Arsenal devant, et à Mika Godts, barré sur les flancs par Jeremy Doku et Diego Moreira. Lui aussi a déjà évolué en faux 9, à l'Ajax.

Recent findings suggest that L'idée sera aussi de regarder dans le réservoir belge. En Espoirs, trois attaquants prouvent qu'ils ont des qualités : Lucas Stassin, Romeo Vermant et Norman Bassette. À tel point que le coach Gill Swerts a cherché un système pour en utiliser au moins deux des trois en même temps. Leur évolution en club fera beaucoup de leur avenir à court terme chez les Diables.".

💡 Key Takeaways
  • It has been revealed that bayern Munich head coach Vincent Kompany has revealed that he deliberately refrained from making any coaching decisions during his recent absence, insisting that assistant coach Aaron Danks and the remaining staff deserved complete responsibility for the team.
  • Danks assumed responsibility for Bayern’s first team after Kompany collapsed during a reserve-team training session on October 23.
  • The results included a 3-1 Bundesliga victory over Freiburg, a 6-1 DFB-Pokal triumph against Magdeburg, a 2-2 draw with Borussia Dortmund, a 2-0 Champions League win away at Atlético Madrid, and a 2-1 victory over Mainz.
📑 Quick Jump: 1. Overview • 2. Key Details • 3. Closing Notes

It has been revealed that bayern Munich head coach Vincent Kompany has revealed that he deliberately refrained from making any coaching decisions during his recent absence, insisting that assistant coach Aaron Danks and the remaining staff deserved complete responsibility for the team. Speaking at Thursday’s press conference ahead of his return to the touchline against Cologne, the 40-year-old offered an interesting insight into his management philosophy and reflected on watching his team succeed from a distance.

Danks assumed responsibility for Bayern’s first team after Kompany collapsed during a reserve-team training session on October 23. The Belgian required hospitalization and an extended period away from his coaching duties. Bayern nevertheless maintained their unbeaten run under Danks, recording four victories and one draw across five competitive fixtures.

The results included a 3-1 Bundesliga victory over Freiburg, a 6-1 DFB-Pokal triumph against Magdeburg, a 2-2 draw with Borussia Dortmund, a 2-0 Champions League win away at Atlético Madrid, and a 2-1 victory over Mainz.

Sources indicate that kompany emphasized that he had deliberately avoided interfering with his assistants’ decision-making throughout the period. Although he maintained contact with the coaching staff and discussed matches afterward, the Belgian insisted that his involvement was limited to understanding their decisions rather than influencing them. The arrangement reflected his conviction that stepping away from responsibility required allowing those taking his place to exercise genuine authority.

According to recent reports, kompany also expressed particular satisfaction with Bayern’s Champions League victory over Atlético Madrid. Watching his players support one another and overcome the Spanish side without him on the touchline represented one of the most memorable experiences of his coaching career. The period away from daily responsibilities also afforded Kompany an unusual opportunity for reflection.

It has been revealed that the Bayern trainer suggested that coaches rarely receive the chance to consider their work from a fresh perspective without leaving their clubs. Although his absence was involuntary, he nevertheless found time to consider how Bayern might improve further upon his return.

Sources indicate that “I didn’t make a single decision. Zero,” Kompany emphasized when discussing his absence at Thursday’s press conference. “But there’s an crucial reason why I wasn’t involved in that decision-making process. You must respect the work. You can’t be there every day, then suddenly not be there anymore, and still insist on having an opinion and making decisions. You simply can’t do that.”.

According to recent reports, “Ultimately, the best place to be is on the bench with the team,” the Bayern coach continued. “But I also enjoyed seeing how the lads stuck together. That really was one of the highlights of my career. As a coach, you never get the chance to have a reboot, a fresh start in your career at the same club. Usually, you have to do that somewhere else. In my case, that’s a luxury I now have.”.

Recent findings suggest that S'il n'a pas encore joué de match officiel en équipe première sous le maillot vert depuis son arrivée dans le Forez le 2 février dernier, Marten-Chris Paalberg, actuellement sous contrat avec l'ASSE jusqu'en 2030, a démarré cet automne 3 matches avec la réserve : 1 en Challenge Espoirs (0-2 face au Mans) et 2 en National 2 (1-1 à Montpellier). Venant d'enchaîner 2 succès en équipe d'Estonie (le premier en sortie de banc au Luxembourg et le second en tant que titulaire contre la Bulgarie), le prometteur attaquant de 18 ans s'est longuement confié à Soccernet. Un long et intéressant entretien que nous avons traduit pour vous !

"Je suis maintenant en pleine forme ! Nouveau club, nouvel environnement. Je pense avoir progressé et maintenant, je vais pouvoir le montrer. Ma santé actuellement ? Disons que tout va bien. Comme j'ai eu des problèmes au genou pendant très longtemps, il arrive que, lorsque les entraînements ou les matchs sont particulièrement intenses, je ressente quelques sensations différentes le lendemain. Mais pour le moment, tout va bien. J'enchaîne les matchs, j'accumule du temps de jeu et je n'ai aucune raison de me plaindre.

Pour être honnête, je ne sais pas exactement quel était mon problème au genou. Tout ce que je peux dire, c'est qu'il y avait un problème au niveau de la rotule et du tendon. À la fin, c'est devenu chronique, ce qui explique pourquoi cela a pris autant de temps. Mais je ne connais pas exactement le diagnostic de mémoire. Je n'ai aucune restriction, mais au sein de l'équipe, on souhaite que je prenne un jour de repos supplémentaire en milieu de semaine après les journées les plus intenses. Ce n'est pas vraiment une restriction, puisque c'est aussi une journée de récupération pour le reste de l'équipe. De mon côté, je fais simplement quelques exercices avec les kinés à l'intérieur.

Industry observers note that mon adaptation et ma vie en France ? J'ai maintenant pris mes marques. Je suis également devenu plus proche de mes coéquipiers et nous sortons régulièrement ensemble. L'année dernière, c'était un peu plus compliqué, mais maintenant tout est facile et tout va bien. Je m'entraîne tous les jours avec les professionnels. Pour le moment, je joue simplement avec la réserve. Mais mon environnement de travail quotidien reste bien celui de l'équipe première.

Je ne peux pas dire quand je ferai mes débuts en équipe première, c'est à l'entraîneur de décider. Pour le moment, la situation est compliquée : l'équipe première est en haut du classement et les attaquants marquent des buts. De mon côté, je fais simplement mon travail. L'occasion finira par arriver et ce sera alors mon heure de me montrer.

Comment je décrirais le niveau de la cinquième division française, notamment par rapport à la Première Ligue estonienne ? Je dirais clairement que le niveau est supérieur. Ce n'est pas non plus un immense fossé, mais le jeu est très physique. En face, on retrouve de grands gaillards, et pas des équipes réserves comme la nôtre. Bon, il y a encore un autre club réserve dans le championnat, mais toutes les autres équipes sont composées de joueurs professionnels. Le jeu est très physique et rapide.

According to recent reports, les séances de l'équipe première sont très intenses et difficiles pour tout le monde. Après l'entraînement, tout le monde termine les mains sur les genoux ! Les premières semaines après mon retour ont été difficiles, mais depuis, les choses vont de mieux en mieux. Je sens que je m'en sors finalement plutôt bien. Les entraîneurs me font également de bons retours et tout me convient.

According to recent reports, je ne saurais pas dire exactement à quel niveau je me situe par rapport aux autres joueurs de l'effectif pro, mais les entraîneurs insistent certainement auprès de nos jeunes joueurs sur la nécessité d'en faire davantage pour progresser et être prêts à être lancés dans le grand bain. Dans l'ensemble, ça se passe bien. Les entraîneurs veulent que je prenne davantage d'initiatives, que je demande plus souvent le ballon et que je sois encore plus actif. C'est ainsi que je pourrai continuer à progresser.

It has been revealed that J'ai également joué au poste de numéro 10. Si je souhaite qu'on fasse de moi un joueur davantage impliqué dans la construction du jeu ? Oui. Chez nous, aussi bien l'équipe première que la réserve évoluent avec deux attaquants. Dans les deux équipes, l'un des deux décroche légèrement. Avec la réserve, j'ai également un autre attaquant à mes côtés, qui joue plutôt comme un véritable avant-centre.

De mon côté, je suis davantage un joueur technique et c'est pour cette raison qu'on souhaite me voir évoluer plus souvent au poste de numéro 10. Cela me convient également, car c'est bien d'avoir plusieurs possibilités. En ce moment, je joue surtout à ce poste, voire même en faux numéro 9. J'ai également expliqué aux entraîneurs que, comme j'ai pratiquement toujours joué en tant qu'avant-centre, je préfère clairement évoluer à ce poste pour le moment. C'est celui auquel je suis le plus habitué.

According to recent reports, jouer numéro 10 avec la réserve reste encore un peu difficile. Il faut s'habituer à évoluer dans un système à deux attaquants. J'aime aussi davantage avoir le ballon et participer au jeu. Aujourd'hui, je dirais que c'est du 50-50 concernant mes préférences, mais pour le moment, j'aimerais quand même jouer davantage tout en haut de l'attaque.

Si je me suis habitué à la vie en France, à la langue française et à tout le reste ? Le français… Je n'ai pas vraiment envie de parler avec les gens, c'est difficile ! (Rires.) Je comprends la langue et nous suivons également des cours de français chaque semaine avec les autres joueurs étrangers. Mais lorsque je me promène en ville, je ne me sens pas encore complètement chez moi. L'environnement est tout de même assez différent, avec davantage de vie urbaine.

Sources indicate that si les rues de Saint-Etienne sont calmes ? Pas du tout ! Il y a des troubles dans toute la France et nous en avons également chez nous. Il y a eu des jours où dans toute la ville, les magasins étaient fermés et barricadés. Il y avait pas mal d'agitation. Cela ne perturbe pas du tout mes déplacements pour aller à l'entraînement. J'habite assez près et le centre d'entraînement se trouve également dans la partie haute de la ville, où il n'y a pas de gros problèmes.

In a recent development, J'ai maintenant trouvé un appartement. Le club dispose d'un responsable qui s'occupe des joueurs et de leurs questions liées à la vie quotidienne. Grâce à lui, nous avons trouvé un appartement agréable à proximité. Personnellement, j'aurais préféré habiter un peu plus loin, mais comme je n'ai pas de voiture, cela aurait été un peu compliqué.

Si je sais me débrouiller tout seul, préparer des pâtes et faire ta lessive ? Bien sûr que je sais faire ! Ma mère s'inquiète beaucoup, mais moi, je m'en sors très bien ! (Rires.) Il n'y a pas vraiment de raison de s'inquiéter. Pour les repas, c'est assez simple : le club dispose d'un service de restauration qui prépare le dîner pour tous les joueurs qui le souhaitent. On peut ensuite récupérer son repas et l'emporter chez soi.

Mon temps libre, je joue un peu à la PlayStation, mais je sors également avec des amis, notamment les plus jeunes joueurs de l'équipe. Ils parlent français et pas vraiment anglais, donc ce n'est pas toujours évident. Mais ils sont vraiment sympas : ils essaient de baragouiner quelques mots en anglais et, de mon côté, je leur réponds en français. C'est un peu un mélange des deux langues, mais ça fonctionne très bien !

Pour être honnête, cette année a été très difficile pour moi mentalement. Quand je suis arrivé là-bas en février, je voulais évidemment commencer à jouer immédiatement. Mais ensuite, ce problème physique est apparu et la situation s'est prolongée, encore et encore. Heureusement, le club dispose d'un psychologue avec qui il est très facile de discuter. Je lui confie régulièrement tout ce que j'ai sur le cœur et il m'a énormément aidé. Ma famille, mes amis et mon agent m'ont également beaucoup soutenu.

It has been revealed that maintenant, ça va mieux. Je joue et je n'ai plus de problème. Il faut simplement continuer à avancer. Je n'ai pas vraiment souffert du mal du pays pendant cette période car j'ai toujours voulu vivre à l'étranger et mener une carrière de footballeur à l'étranger. Pour moi, cela a été assez facile, mais vous pouvez imaginer ce que ma famille a pu ressentir… Ma mère pleurait régulièrement au téléphone, alors que de mon côté, je le vivais plutôt bien. Je ne me faisais pas de souci à ce sujet. Je voulais simplement guérir et recommencer à jouer.

Recent findings suggest that L'année dernière, lorsque j'étais en sélection en novembre, j'ai commencé à ressentir quelque chose vers la fin du rassemblement, avant le match contre Chypre. Mais ensuite, la douleur a disparu. Tout semblait simple, je n'avais aucun problème et je m'entraînais normalement. Mais il est possible que le rythme ait été particulièrement intense avec l'équipe première. Là-bas non plus, je n'avais pas vraiment de repos : j'ai immédiatement repris le travail et le même problème est revenu. La différence de charge de travail a donc pu jouer un rôle.

Si cela pourrait être lié à la croissance ? Certainement. Il faut aussi prendre en compte le fait que l'année dernière, lorsque je jouais au Vaprus, j'étais également présent à chaque rassemblement international avec les différentes sélections. Je ne prenais donc pas de repos, contrairement aux autres joueurs qui avaient tout de même quelques jours de congé. À chaque retour de sélection, je reprenais immédiatement l'entraînement et les matchs s'enchaînaient.

According to recent reports, ma taille ? 1,85 m. Cela fait déjà quelque temps. Dans quelle mesure le changement d'entraîneur l'été dernier à Saint-Etienne cela a modifié ou influencé ma situation ? Cela n'a rien changé. Lorsqu'il est arrivé, nous avons immédiatement discuté et il m'a dit qu'il m'appréciait et qu'il me voyait dans ses prepares. Il fallait simplement que je retrouve la pleine forme et que je puisse désormais lui montrer progressivement ce dont je suis capable.".

📑 Quick Jump: 1. Overview • 2. Key Details • 3. Closing Notes

According to reports from Italy, Liverpool are regularly scouting a red-hot striker who’s emerged as a shock candidate for the Golden Boot in Serie A this season.

Andoni Iraola has been almost exclusively reliant on Alexander Isak at centre-forward since taking charge of the Reds in the summer, with Hugo Ekitike continuing his recovery from a long-term Achilles injury.

The Frenchman is targeting a return to action next month (The Athletic), although it appears that Anfield chiefs are keeping tabs on a positional alternative who’s emerging as a breakthrough sensation in one of Europe’s major leagues.

A report from Corriere dello Sport has claimed that Liverpool are sending scouts ‘every week’ to watch Gustavo Varela, who’s been in remarkable goalscoring form with Monza since joining the Serie A outfit in the summer.

Napoli and Juventus have also been strongly linked with the 21-year-old, who’s been the subject of enquiries from Tottenham, Brentford and Sunderland, with the list of suitors growing in tandem with his goal return in the Italian top flight.

Ivan Juric’s side reportedly want €40m (£33.5m) for the Portuguese hitman, which’d represent a monumental profit on a player they signed from Gil Vicente in July for a paltry €2.5m (£2.1m).

(Photo by Marco Luzzani/Getty Images).

According to recent reports, want more Empire of the Kop coverage? Add us as a preferred source on Google to your favourites list for news you can trust.

Varela is presently the leading scorer in Serie A this season with nine goals, which is remarkable when his team are currently in the relegation zone, and he accounts for more than half of their goal tally in the top flight so far.

According to recent reports, for someone who’d scored just seven times in 34 senior appearances before the summer, his form since joining Monza has been extraordinary. Should that continue, it’s safe to say that he won’t be at the Stadio Brianteo for much longer.

What Liverpool would need to consider is whether this is a mere purple patch from the Portuguese youngster, or the start of a journey towards being one of Europe’s most feared centre-forwards.

Varela has scored nine Serie A goals from an xG of just 5.48 (Fotmob), an astonishing overperformance which begs the question as to whether he can maintain that for a full campaign.

If Isak keeps up his own hot streak and Ekitike gets back to the levels he’d shown prior to his injury, it’d be difficult to see the Monza striker getting much of a look-in at Anfield.

However, it’s easy to see why Liverpool are routinely dispatching scouts to gather information on one of the breakout stars of European football in 2026.

En effet, le club caladois annonce le prêt du latéral gauche par le club nordiste : "Nous sommes heureux d’annoncer l’arrivée de Maedine Makhloufi, prêté par l’USL Dunkerque jusqu’à la fin de la saison !Formé à l’AS Saint Etienne de ses 8 ans jusqu’au monde senior, il signe en Ligue 2, à Dunkerque, l’an dernier."Maedine Makhloufi espère faire partie du onze qui viendra défier les Verts en Coupe de France : "Je suis très heureux d’être prêté au FCVB et de retrouver une région que je connais et que j’apprécie ! Le hasard du tirage va me faire retrouver l’ASSE et le chaudron. J’espère que ce sera un beau match et que le meilleur gagne".

Il va retrouver à Villefranche un autre ancien Vert, le défenseur central Marvin Tshibuabua.

Maedine Makhloufi était en manque de temps de jeu avec l'US Dunkerque :  sur les 12 rencontres disputées en Ligue 2, il n'a pas été retenu dans le groupe à 8 reprises, est resté sur le banc sans entrer à 3 reprises et n'est entré que pour 9 petites minutes contre Rodez le 30 octobre. La saison dernière, sur 16 matchs disputés par Dunkerque, il avait été titulaire à 3 reprises, était entré en jeu à 5 reprises. Lors de son entrée pour 4 minutes face à Boulogne, il avait inscrit 1 but lors de ce derby qui avait vu Dinkerque l'emporetr par 6 à 2.Avec les Verts, Maedine Makhloufi n'a disputé qu'un seul match en pro, contre la modeste équipe de Quetigny à Dijon en Coupe de France.

The future of Virgil van Dijk continues to be a much-discussed talking point going into the winter months.

The legendary Liverpool captain will see his current contract expire next June as things stand, with the Dutchman on track to become a free agent just before his 36th birthday.

Transfer insider Graeme Bailey recently claimed that there’s a strong chance of the veteran defender being offered at least a 12-month extension at Anfield, with Andoni Iraola unsurprisingly keen to keep hold of his skipper.

In his latest Liverpool Confidential feature for the Daily Mail, Lewis Steele reported of fervent interest from Serie A in Van Dijk amid ongoing speculation over the centre-back’s future.

The journalist wrote: ‘One source told me this week that AC Milan and other Italian clubs have been sniffing around Van Dijk for some time, with talks ongoing internally at those sides.

‘Milan owner Gerry Cardinale and influential adviser Zlatan Ibrahimovic are mentioned to be huge admirers of Van Dijk, who turns 36 next summer.’.

While the Rossoneri appear determined to pounce on any uncertainty over Van Dijk’s future, Steele added that the 35-year-old is ‘keen’ to extend his contract at Liverpool.

(Photo by Carl Recine/Getty Images).

Recent findings suggest that want more Empire of the Kop coverage? Add us as a preferred source on Google to your favourites list for news you can trust.

Any reports of interest in the Dutchman from other clubs will naturally trigger a level of concern among Reds supporters, but it’s natural that there’d be a queue of suitors for one of the best defenders of his (perhaps any) generation when he’s seven months away from becoming a free agent.

Industry observers note that until such time that a final decision is communicated by LFC, fans’ nerves will be frayed as to Van Dijk’s future. When we’ve already seen Mo Salah and Andy Robertson depart this year, the loss of another modern-day great in 2027 would represent a further gut punch for Kopites.

However, it’s worth remembering that when the Liverpool captain last penned a upcoming contract in April 2025, he was just over two months away from leaving on a free, so he won’t panic even if there might be considerable gnashing of teeth outside of those involved in negotiations over his future.

James Pearce recently advised Reds supporters not to expect a ‘quick resolution’ over the defender’s situation, so for now, it seems that the best way for Van Dijk to secure a latest deal at Anfield is to maintain the strong performance levels he’s shown so far this season.

The noise over his future is sure to continue for the time being, but we remain confident that everything will come together in due course and that our iconic number 4 will continue to grace the famous red shirt in the 2027/28 campaign.

It took just 46 seconds for PSV to get off the mark as Sven Mijnans headed in unmarked.

The midfielder added a second after 15 minutes and completed his hat-trick with a free-kick in the 80th minute to make the score 4-2, just as Cambuur were threatening a comeback.

Goals just before half-time by Abdelnour Soualhia and Patrick Brouwer brought Telstar back into the game, but neither side was able to find a winner after the break.

That result allowed ADO, under the guidance of interim coach Levi Schwiebbe, to close the gap on 16th-placed Telstar to one point with a 3-1 win against Sparta, while bottom Willem II collected their third point of the season at home to PEC Zwolle.

Senza Zaccagni, Gattuso prepara Noslin sulla sinistra; Frattesi si è allenato in gruppo, ma resta il dubbio sul suo impiego.

Andrea Pinamonti giocherà per la prima volta da titolare all’Olimpico con la Lazio nella sfida di sabato contro il Lecce. CLICCA QUI E SEGUI LAZIOPRESS.IT ANCHE SU INSTAGRAM.

It has been revealed that nelle due precedenti gare iniziate da titolare, a Udine e Napoli, il numero 9 arrivato in estate non ha convinto. È stato sostituito nella ripresa, rispettivamente al 52’ e al 61’. Sabato spera che la prima partenza dall’inizio in casa segni un cambiamento.

Recent findings suggest that proprio all’Olimpico, entrando nel secondo tempo, ha segnato i suoi due gol con la Lazio. Contro il Lecce, Noslin prenderà il posto di Zaccagni sulla fascia sinistra, mentre Pinamonti agirà al centro. L’intesa tra l’attaccante italiano e l’olandese è ancora da affinare, ma Gattuso è convinto che la formula possa funzionare.

#15536. Alexander Isak starts to justify £125m price tag with double

📅 04 Sep 2026 • ⏱️ 26m • 📚 Deep Dive (5269 w)
📖 Baca
General ⚖️ Neutral 🌐 Co ↗ Open Full Page

Alexander Isak starts to justify £125m price tag with double

📅 04 Sep 2026 | ⏱️ 26 min read (5269 words, 📚 Deep Dive) | Source: Co

⏱️ ~26 mins left to finish
📖 0% read
💡 Key Takeaways
  • There was a centre-forward who played for Newcastle a couple of years ago.
  • Everyone wanted him, but Liverpool signed him for £125m in August 2025.
  • If you had wondered what had happened to him, he reappeared at Portman Road.
📑 Quick Jump: 1. Overview • 2. Key Details • 3. Closing Notes

There was a centre-forward who played for Newcastle a couple of years ago. Do you remember him? He was as quick as greased lightning, played on his instincts, had a shot like cannon and could come up with a finish for every situation.

Everyone wanted him, but Liverpool signed him for £125m in August 2025. His name was Alexander Isak but shortly after arriving on Merseyside, it was like he went missing, as the guy who played in red last season bore only a physical resemblance to the guy who had played in black-and-white.

If you had wondered what had happened to him, he reappeared at Portman Road. They say good things come to those who wait. Although nobody at Liverpool would have expected such a delay to see the real Isak, there were no complaints that his career at the club has finally taken off.

Taking the headlines from Bradley Barcola on a big night at Portman Road was going to take some doing, but Isak did just that with a double salvo in the opening nine minutes, a flurry so potent it was like a boxer charging out of their corner and seeing the first blows land flush on their opponent’s jaw.

It has been revealed that poor Ipswich. There is universal recognition that Liverpool are a team – and a club – in transition but they had four players in Isak, Florian Wirtz, Cody Gakpo and Victor Muñoz who had the potential to dismantle the hosts if they clicked and that is precisely what happened.

Industry observers note that “With Alex, it is clear,” stated Andoni Iraola. “If he is fit, if he is available, if he is in a good shape, he will produce the numbers. My demand with Alex will not be about the goals. It will be about other things so we can play well. And if we play well, we are in good positions. Then goals will come.”.

So for all the noisy backing they received from the stands and for all the effort Gary O’Neil’s side put into a contest that TV companies had chosen to broadcast because there was a potential for drama, Isak blew a hole in Ipswich’s hull in the sixth minute and they were submerging from there on in.

A blistering finish from Alexander Isak! 💥 pic.twitter.com/jSGlIZsQtA.

Recent findings suggest that how Isak, who had scored against Nottingham Forest last weekend, needed a night like this when he made a genuine difference. But the same was true, too, for Iraola. We live in an era where someone has to be in the eye of a storm and the Basque will know what comes with his upcoming territory.

It had clearly irritated Iraola that Liverpool had gone behind four times in their opening two fixtures and during his pre-match media briefing, he effectively gave a sermon at one point on how slow starts, or giving the opposition a helping hand, would no longer be tolerated.

In a recent development, quietly, Iraola is making his presence felt. The task he faces is significantly different than the one O’Neil is accomplishing – keeping Ipswich in the division against the odds – but Liverpool’s head coach is a man who knows his own mind and is not afraid to make decisions.

He had responded to criticism of his midfield at Newcastle on the opening weekend by dropping Ryan Gravenberch for the fixture with Forest and his response to scrutiny about his right-back seven days ago was to drop Jeremie Frimpong and bring in Ronald Araújo.

Sources indicate that iraola certainly picked the right team: Araújo, the loan capture from Barcelona, added stature to the back four and there was harmony in how they moved. The Uruguayan’s first instinct was to stay back and Liverpool looked better for it, even if O’Neil, incredibly, felt Ipswich had the better of things.

Emersonn, Ipswich’s Brazilian striker, did not see the ball in the opening exchanges and, by the time he did, Liverpool had zoomed into the distance to such an extent that you felt it was going to be impossible for them to peg their visitors back.

“I hate having to talk about good performances when you do not get points,” O’Neil declared to a room full of raised eyebrows and you can only assume his message was to ensure that morale in the dressing room was not drooping.

Recent findings suggest that what damage was inflicted with Liverpool’s first significant attack. Gakpo, the subject of an £80m bid from Manchester City, was never going to allow transfer speculation to disrupt his focus and he nudged a perfect little ball into Isak’s path in the sixth minute to show his wellbeing.

The next move declared the return of Isak. One touch gave him an avenue to shoot, the next was a shot with his right foot that was so hard from 16 yards, on an angle, it bent the wrists of Kjell Scherpen as it howled into the net. Critics will feel Ipswich’s keeper should have done better.

Your first thought was to think of the first goal Isak scored in English football in September 2022, a similarly venomous drive, against Liverpool at Anfield. He oozed quality that evening, his pace and skill had Jürgen Klopp’s defenders persistently fretting and this is what he was doing again.

Sources indicate that it was no coincidence that three minutes later, he came up with another wonderful goal. This one owed much to the beautiful pass Gakpo presented to him, an inch-perfect through ball with the outside of his right foot, but Isak still demonstrated great poise to bamboozle Scherpen.

In a recent development, inside NINE minutes Alexander Isak has two goals! ⚡️ pic.twitter.com/3UGq0bwqRm.

“He owes me a few assists now!” chirped the selfless Gakpo.

A hat-trick could have arrived in the 32nd minute but Isak was a kneecap offside as he dispatched a pass from Wirtz and, perhaps, he will have been disappointed to have made way on the hour having not secured the match ball for his efforts.

Liverpool, too, will be frustrated that they did not made sure of three points before the time Isak made way for Barcola – what Alexis Mac Alliser was thinking when he fluffed an unmarked header from six yards, only he will know – but it was not a night to nitpick.

It has been revealed that there will be easier assignments on the horizon for Ipswich, even though O’Neil insisted they more than held their own against world-class opponents. And you can say for sure there will be more goals and wins for Liverpool and Isak if they continue in this encouraging manner.

Industry observers note that “I witnessed what a great coach he was at Bournemouth. He is not the sort of manager you are going to see making clever patterns in his box. He just does not see the risk. He will want to get the ball to the players who want to make a difference. Coaches do not show how good they are by how they play out from the back. The key thing is when you get it in the final third, you make things happen. That is what he will want to improve. He will want Alexander Isak when he has not got the ball to press. He will want the same of Florian Wirtz. The difficulty will come with Champions League football and not putting too many demands on his players. If he gets it right, he has got a wonderful squad to work with.”.

"My demands will not be about the goals, my fights with him are about other stuff." Andoni Iraola speaking about Alexander Isak 🔊 pic.twitter.com/B4zUG2IGfS.

“He has had good minutes, a good pass in a counter, a good couple of chances when he was going against the goalkeeper and we have not found him. We need to learn these movements because he will be there threatening in behind all the team. But he looks confident on the ball as always. We are about to find out the two starting XIs at Portman Road. Will Bradley Barcola start for Liverpool on his debut?

The third matchday of the new Premier League season kicks off at Portman Road as newly-promoted Ipswich host Liverpool.

It has been revealed that andoni Iraola has drawn his first two games in charge of Liverpool, both 2-2 stalemates against Newcastle and Nottingham Forest respectively. Liverpool secured a move for forward Bradley Barcola from PSG in the final few days on the window for a fee that could rise to £123m and the Frenchman is set to make his Liverpool debut tonight.

Recent findings suggest that “We are very happy with Bradley,” Iraola said. “He was our priority; to sign a very good player in that position. He has come with the right mentality. I like that he wanted Liverpool a lot, he just wanted to come here. That is a good first sign. Being the player he is and the things he has won recently, he has come with the willingness to help us. I am very happy with him.

It has been revealed that “He trained well with us, and if everything goes well in today’s [Thursday] training, he will definitely be available for tomorrow [tonight]. He has trained with us three times. He has not had minutes in pre-season but he has been training normally with the group. It is a decision we have to make. We have to consider that he has not had minutes in pre-season.”.

Liverpool won both fixtures when Ipswich were last in the Premier League two seasons ago, including a 2-0 win on the opening weekend in Arne Slot’s first game in charge of Liverpool as they went on to win the Premier League that season.

Ipswich won their first home game on their return to the Premier League, beating Sunderland 2-1 on the opening weekend. However, they fell to a 5-2 defeat in their first away game at Manchester United. Over the course of the summer transfer window, Ipswich made a total of 14 signings and spent over £200m.

“What we can do is perform in a way that always gives us a real chance, which we have done so far,” Ipswich boss Gary O’Neil mentioned. “We were in that game at Manchester United until a couple of moments took it away from us. We were in it, so that is what we need to do, we need to make sure that no matter who it is, whether it is Liverpool, Manchester United, Manchester City, when they come to Portman Road, we need to make sure we are right in the game to give ourselves opportunities. We will always be a threat; we have scored four goals in two games. That is really good for a promoted side. We look a goal threat, and we need to keep that going and that will be tested.”.

Team news from Portman Road to follow shortly.

The most famous name in Dutch football could appear on an international men’s team sheet for the first time in 30 years after Johan Cruyff’s grandson was called up for the United States’ upcoming matches in Europe.

Shae Cruijff-Beane, the son of Johan Cruyff’s daughter Chantal and her American husband Todd Beane, was included in the squad that will play against Norway and Portugal in the next seven days.

Cruijff-Beane plays as a midfielder for Gimnàstic de Tarragona, a club in the Spanish third tier based near Barcelona. His older brother Jordan also came through the club’s ranks and is currently playing US college football at Westmont College in California.

Shae, 17, is eligible to play for the USA through his father and Spain and the Netherlands through his mother, who spent part of her childhood in Catalonia while Johan Cruyff was playing for Barcelona in the 1970s.

The USA under-18 squad also includes an Ajax player, midfielder Xander Newstead, who grew up in San Francisco and joined the Amsterdam club’s youth team set-up at the age of 10, beforec signing professional terms last year.

Johan Cruyff went on to play in the United States for Los Angeles Aztecs and Washington Diplomats before returning to the Netherlands, winding down his career at Ajax and Feyenoord.

In a recent development, his son Jordi played for Barcelona and Manchester United and won nine international caps in 1996. Last year he was appointed technical director at Ajax, the club where his father began his career.

Niko Kovac demands fast Borussia Dortmund restart, and hopes GTA 6 doesn’t get in the way

📑 Quick Jump: 1. Overview • 2. Key Details • 3. Closing Notes

Niko Kovac had an unusual concern to contend with ahead of Borussia Dortmund’s return to Bundesliga action: the release of Grand Theft Auto 6.

Asked at Thursday’s press conference whether the eagerly anticipated video game had become a major topic inside the BVB dressing room, Kovac joked that he hoped none of his players had been staying up deep into the night playing it.

The Dortmund head coach conceded that several members of his squad were likely already heavily involved with the game, quipping that he hoped they would not “confuse day and night” ahead of Saturday’s trip to Borussia Mönchengladbach.

The light-hearted exchange came at the end of a press conference otherwise dominated by Dortmund’s need to hit the ground running following the international break.

BVB travel to bottom-of-the-table Gladbach on Saturday at 15:30 CET with 21 points from their opening nine Bundesliga matches. Kovac’s side remain unbeaten in league play and sit second, level on points with leaders Bayern Munich. Dortmund have also conceded only seven goals, the best defensive record in the division.

Industry observers note that “We can’t afford to take any time to get going,” Kovac remarked. “There are still eight games left this year. In these games, we want to cement our place at the top of the Bundesliga. The other teams are pushing from behind. We have to be ready right away.”.

In a recent development, saturday’s match begins another demanding stretch for Dortmund. BVB face eight competitive fixtures in 29 days before the winter break, having only just completed a run of nine matches across 29 of days prior to the November international break.

The experience of the previous international break also provides an obvious warning.

Dortmund failed to win any of their first three matches after returning to club action in October, drawing 2-2 with Werder Bremen and 0-0 with Union Berlin in the Bundesliga either side of a 1-0 Champions League defeat to Bodø/Glimt.

Industry observers note that kovac nevertheless believes the circumstances are somewhat different this time. The Dortmund coach noted that the latest international window involved a more conventional two-match schedule rather than the unusually heavy international programme surrounding the previous break, leaving his players closer to their normal competitive rhythm.

Getting into matches more quickly has become an increasingly prominent theme for Dortmund. BVB’s last ten Bundesliga goals have all arrived after half-time, an unusual run that Kovac would preferably bring to an end in Gladbach.

“If you take an early lead, the game opens up much more rapidly,” Kovac said.

The trend has done little damage to Dortmund’s results so far, but it has repeatedly forced BVB to remain patient before finding breakthroughs. Five of their nine Bundesliga matches this season have reached half-time without Dortmund scoring.

Recent findings suggest that kovac will also have several late personnel decisions to make. Serhou Guirassy, Waldemar Anton, and Carney Chukwuemeka remained in Dortmund during the international break while dealing with muscular problems. Kovac said that their availability would be assessed ahead of the weekend and stressed that “nothing is ruled out.”.

Samuele Inacio has meanwhile returned from international duty carrying a minor complaint, leaving another question mark over Dortmund’s squad for Saturday.

The mood became considerably lighter when Kovac was questioned about the release of Grand Theft Auto 6.

In a recent development, A reporter asked whether the Dortmund coach had encountered an unusual number of players requesting a “sick day” following the game’s release and whether GTA had become a major topic inside the dressing room. Kovac was also asked whether he owned a PlayStation 5 himself.

Recent findings suggest that “I don’t have one,” Kovac responded. “I reached the age at which I’m out. I believe I heard or read some time ago that this game was coming out. I hope my lads haven’t been playing deep into the night. How does one do something like that these days? Per App or does one need hardware [a gaming console]?”.

The reporter clarified that the game could be downloaded on a console, adding that BVB striker Fabio Silva had commented on downloading it in the three days since its release.

“Okay, then I’ll act on the assumption that they [the players] are playing it,” Kovac continued. “I hope they don’t play it so excessively that they can’t tell day from night anymore. That could be problematic. But today is a wonderful day not just because of the fact that this game is being released, but because we also have two in-house birthdays with Costa [Konstantinos Karetsas] and Joey [Veerman].

“That’s much more notable than this game,” Kovac concluded. “But I have heard that a few [of the players] are intensively involved [with the video game].”.

Ancien défenseur des Verts, le consultant de beIN Sports Patrice Ferri (63 ans) s'est confié à L'Union avant le déplacement de l'ASSE à Reims programmé après-demain soir. Extraits.

Recent findings suggest that "Sainté, c'est la seule véritable équipe à avoir le moins de trous d'air possible et qui parvient à tenir la distance. C'est ce qu'il faut prendre en compte. Et il y a quelque chose de supplémentaire à Saint-Etienne, c'est l'engouement du public. Comme si l'équipe jouait le haut du tableau de Ligue 1. C’est un élément qui peut faire la différence, bien sûr. Mais ces clubs-là, qui ont une grosse pression, ça peut aussi les perturber à un moment donné. Ceux qui y ont été formés comme ça a été mon cas, ils connaissent très vite cet univers. Tout va plus vite dans ce club. On est tout de suite plongé dans ce milieu professionnel où les résultats sont attendus, où l'engagement de l'équipe est scruté à chaque instant. C'est comme une pieuvre.

Industry observers note that A Saint-Etienne, la pression fait partie du club, du package. C'est comme si tu signais au PSG actuellement. C'est la même situation. Le Stade de Reims et l’ASSE ne sont pas totalement dans les mêmes dispositions en termes d'attente. Je ne suis pas persuadé que c'était tout de suite l'idée impérative du Stade de Reims de remonter. Ce n'est pas une obligation ni une nécessité, que ce soit économique ou sportive. Ils ne sont pas dans la même configuration que Saint-Etienne. Quand tu as 35 000 spectateurs au stade en Ligue 2, on se doute bien que le club ne peut pas rester des années dans la division.

It has been revealed that le match de ce samedi, ça fait partie des grosses rencontres. Tout le monde trouverait normal que ce soit un match de Ligue 1. Saint-Etienne a besoin de continuer à creuser l'écart qui est loin d'être énorme. De son côté, Reims a la nécessité de faire bonne figure et de réaliser un gros match. Ne serait-ce que par rapport à l'affiche, mais surtout pour ne pas se faire décrocher du top 5. Pour moi, à part Saint-Etienne, pour les autres, ce serait une erreur de vouloir uniquement se positionner pour le top 2. Les matchs sont tellement compliqués que c'est difficile de faire des séries. C'est devenu trop difficile à maîtriser.".

Gudmundsson ha completato il recupero ed è atteso per la partita contro il Lecce. Anche Rovella rientra tra le opzioni a disposizione.

According to recent reports, nell’ultimo aggiornamento sull’infermeria rossoblù, Frendrup è indicato come unico indisponibile. Venturino non compare più tra le assenze segnalate.

Gli esami di Akanji hanno dato esito negativo dopo l’affaticamento accusato con la Svizzera; il suo rientro ad Appiano è previsto il 18 novembre. I fastidi al piede di Zielinski non destano particolare preoccupazione, ma saranno ricontrollati al ritorno dalla Nazionale.

Cambiaso, Celik e Nico Gonzalez hanno lavorato a parte anche il 17 novembre e restano in dubbio. Pavlovic ha ripreso parzialmente il lavoro in gruppo e punta alla convocazione; Terracciano è ancora da valutare dopo il trauma alla spalla.

Industry observers note that non sono uniformi le ricostruzioni disponibili su Ziolkowski, Pessina, Ciurria, Mout e Ngonge, presenti nelle precedenti segnalazioni. The Netherlands came crashing down to earth after hammering Greece as they were outclassed and outmuscled by Germany in Berlin.

Oranje went into the final match of the Nations League group stage with high hopes of recording their first win over their old rivals in seven matches stretching back to 2019.

Instead they suffered their second worst defeat ever at the hands of Germany, but still progressed to the knockout stages thanks to their thumping 7-0 win in Amsterdam on Friday.

Coach Xavi Hernandez was forced to make one change in midfield as Jurriën Timber replaced Barcelona’s Frenkie de Jong, who pulled out with an obturator muscle strain.

Germany shaded the first half and went ahead five minutes before the break when Freiburg striker Derry Scherhant cut in from the left hand side and beat Bart Verbruggen with a curling strike into the top corner.

Scherhant had struck the post minutes earlier, while the Dutch might have taken the lead earlier when Crysencio Summerville slipped in the penalty area as he tried to control a cross by Cody Gakpo.

It has been revealed that but in the second half the Dutch fell apart. In the 60th minute Florian Wirtz shoved Denzel Dumfries off the ball and had space to tee up a left-footed shot from the edge of the area that gave Verbruggen no chance.

Nico Schlotterbeck added a third from a free-kick five minutes later, before Wirtz drifted past Gakpo on the right side of the penalty area to score his second.

The humiliation was complete when Brajan Gruda capped a fine attacking performance by firing in a rebound.

According to recent reports, dumfries made no excuses afterwards for what he admitted was a “terrible performance”. “We gave the ball away too easily, left too much space and were too weak in the challenges,” he told NOS. “We can’t let that happen.”.

Ligue 1 outfit AS Monaco have reached an agreement with German youth international Paris Brunner (20) regarding a contract extension beyond 2028, according to RMC Sport, as reported via our colleagues at Get French Football News.

The young attacker is expected to sign a contract through to 2030 after scoring eight goals and providing one assists in 13 matches for Monaco in 2026/27 after joining the Principality club from Borussia Dortmund in the summer in search of senior football, having not made an appearance for BVB’s first team.

Brunner’s performances also coincided with a run in Antonio Di Salvo’s Germany U21 squad during the recent international break where he featured in defeats against Belgium and Croatia. He was, though, one of the winners in Germany’s youth team, which also saw the youngster earn praise from Di Salvo. “Moving Paris [to the left] was something that we wanted as we wanted to have a player like that on the left [wing]. It paid off on our second goal,” he explained.

Suivant de près l'actualité du MHSC, Benjamin Psaume est revenu dans le podcast Montpellier Sport Club (relayé par Allez Paillade) sur le match de Coupe de France qui a vu les Héraultais écraser (5-0) le FC Balagne en Corse. L'ancien joueur de Toulouse, Nîmes, Arles-Avignon, Troyes et Le Puy ne tarit pas d'éloges sur Zoumana Camara :.

"En coupe de France, dans des matchs comme cela où il manque beaucoup de monde, le plus important c’est la qualification. Zoumana Camara a lancé des jeunes. C’est à l’image de ce qu’il montre depuis le début de saison. Il a tellement fédéré le groupe et le vestiaire que peu importe les joueurs qu’il peut mettre, on sent qu’ils sont animés par une envie. Ils ne réfléchissent pas au contexte même s’il est particulier, ils ont envie de faire mal à l’adversaire. Ils ont un enthousiasme dès la première minute. Ils répondent présents. Et quand tu marques à la première minute dans des matchs comme ça, je me suis dit que c’était terminé même si après ils ont eu des occasions. Quand tu es le gros face au “petit”, tu sais que si tu ouvres le score c’est plus facile.

According to recent reports, le football a changé car avant, ils mettaient le bus et là tu arrives à les prendre dans la profondeur au bout d’une minute. Cela n’existait pas à mon époque quand tu allais jouer chez une équipe de niveau inférieur. Il n’y a pas eu trop de coups, le synthétique n’a pas joué de mauvais tour non plus. Il n’y a pas eu l’ambiance corse qu’il y avait avant. Tu te rends le match facile. On a découvert des jeunes joueurs. Ils ont réussi sur un tour où on ne leur en aurait pas voulu sur la manière à la mettre pour l’emporter en respectant l’adversaire. Ils ont donné une bonne image du club, ils ont également laissé la recette. À deux ou trois à zéro, ils ont continué. Ce vestiaire, ce groupe là, dans la psychologie, cela m’aurait étonné qu’ils prennent le match de haut. C’est très intéressant et à l’image de ce que l’on voit depuis le début de la saison.".

L’ex biancoceleste elogia il gioco di Gattuso e la forza del gruppo, ma indica nella prima sconfitta una prova da superare.

According to recent reports, secondo quanto riportato da La Gazzetta dello Sport, Nestor Sensini crede nella possibilità che la Lazio vinca lo scudetto. L’ex biancoceleste considera il titolo una sorta di miracolo sportivo, ma vede nella squadra di Gattuso le condizioni per provarci: «Ha tutte le qualità per centrare l’impresa.» Cita l’ambiente, la grinta e la preparazione tattica dell’allenatore, oltre alla consapevolezza che il gruppo sta acquisendo partita dopo partita.

CLICCA QUI E SEGUI LAZIOPRESS.IT ANCHE SU INSTAGRAM.

Il legame di Sensini con la Lazio risale al titolo conquistato in biancoceleste. Pur essendo affezionato anche a Udinese e Parma, ricorda soprattutto la festa vissuta a Roma: «Alla Lazio ho conquistato il mio scudetto. Quell’esperienza si è appiccicata alla pelle, la festa di un popolo intero. Come si fa a dimenticare una cosa così?».

Recent findings suggest that per Sensini, il gioco è uno dei punti di forza della Lazio. Gattuso ha dato alla squadra un’identità precisa: sa difendere e attaccare coinvolgendo l’intero organico. L’ex calciatore attribuisce questo risultato alla capacità del tecnico di convincere tutti della validità delle proprie idee.

According to recent reports, richiamando la sua esperienza in diversi spogliatoi, anche in quelli dove giocava Maradona, Sensini osserva che può esserci qualche scontento perfino quando arrivano i risultati. Alla Lazio, invece, gli sembra di vedere un gruppo unito, senza prime donne né i fuoriclasse della squadra con cui vinse lo scudetto, ma disposto a lavorare per un obiettivo comune. «In questa squadra vedo il carattere del suo allenatore», dice.

Tra i singoli cita Zaccagni, Noslin e Frattesi, pur insistendo sul collettivo e sulla disponibilità a fare una corsa in più per aiutare un compagno in difficoltà.

In a recent development, sensini riconosce che Inter e Roma hanno rose superiori per qualità e quantità e che i mezzi finanziari della Lazio non sono paragonabili a quelli degli altri club. Per questo fa i complimenti ai tecnici e ai dirigenti che hanno individuato i giocatori adatti al progetto di Gattuso. Ritiene comunque meritata la posizione della Lazio: «Nove vittorie, due pareggi e zero sconfitte: il cammino è fantastico.».

Recent findings suggest that il suo dubbio riguarda la risposta della squadra a un risultato negativo: «Prima o poi arriverà una sconfitta e bisognerà vedere come il gruppo reagirà alla caduta.» Sensini è convinto che Gattuso saprà affrontare anche quei momenti, purché l’ambiente resti vicino ai giocatori. Sulla corsa al titolo si sbilancia: «Lo stesso dovranno fare i suoi giocatori, e mi sbilancio: alla fine, ce la faranno. E io sarò a festeggiare con loro».

#15523. Gasly takes shock Italian GP pole and denies Russell

📅 05 Sep 2026 • ⏱️ 16m • 📚 Deep Dive (3275 w)

Gasly takes shock Italian GP pole and denies Russell

📅 05 Sep 2026 | ⏱️ 16 min read (3275 words, 📚 Deep Dive) | Source: Co

⏱️ ~16 mins left to finish
📖 0% read
💡 Key Takeaways
  • Sometimes inspiration can come from the unlikeliest of sources.
  • It turned out Gasly and Russell had been playing online chess until about 15 minutes before qualifying.
  • “Since the [drivers’] briefing last night, I figured out that he [Russell] is obsessed with chess, and so am I,” Gasly explained later in his press conference.
📑 Quick Jump: 1. Overview • 2. Key Details • 3. Closing Notes

Sometimes inspiration can come from the unlikeliest of sources. After claiming the first pole of his Formula One career, an absolutely stunning effort in his 192nd attempt – edging out Mercedes’ George Russell right at the death – Alpine’s Pierre Gasly revealed that a harmless jibe from his performance coach Ben Thorpe just before the session started had riled him up.

It turned out Gasly and Russell had been playing online chess until about 15 minutes before qualifying.

“Since the [drivers’] briefing last night, I figured out that he [Russell] is obsessed with chess, and so am I,” Gasly explained later in his press conference. “There are a few of us in the paddock who are. So we have exchanged our IDs on Chess.com and we have had a little game going on.

In a recent development, “I won yesterday, and another one that carried on into today,” the Frenchman added. “I was feeling confident and I was picking [taking] piece after piece. Then Ben told me: ‘You are getting George here but he is going to get you in a few minutes!’. And I thought ‘F--- off!’.”.

In a recent development, what a way to break your duck. And what a day on which to do it. On Friday, Gasly lost his only podium of the season when the International Court of Appeal reinstated two five-second penalties he received in Monaco, dropping him from third to seventh in that race. The ruling produced fireworks when Flavio Briatore, Alpine’s executive adviser, then accused one of the judges on the ICA panel of being biased towards McLaren, one of two teams who had brought the appeal.

Industry observers note that another 24 hours later, the fireworks were for all the right reasons. And there was no appealing the result; the start of Russell’s final lap in Q3 was slightly compromised by Red Bull’s Max Verstappen, but the Englishman could have no real complaints, losing out by 0.060secs in the end, prompting wild celebrations in the Alpine garage.

To say the result was a surprise would be an understatement. This was the Enstone team’s first pole in 17 years, since Fernando Alonso took P1 Renault at the 2009 Hungarian Grand Prix.

Recent findings suggest that the warning signs were there. Alpine had been quick all weekend. But the Tifosi packing Monza’s grandstands fully expected it to be a battle between Mercedes and their beloved Ferrari for pole.

In a recent development, the Scuderia’s performance was underwhelming. Charles Leclerc and Lewis Hamilton were only ninth and 10th quickest in Q2, the latter squeaking into Q3 by one thousandth of a second from Audi’s Gabriel Bortoleto. “F--- me,” Hamilton said after dodging that bullet.

And although they improved a bit in Q3, Hamilton managing to claim P5, just behind Leclerc in P4, they never threatened the front row. In fact, they later got lucky as McLaren’s Oscar Piastri, who took P3, was later hit with a three-place grid drop post-qualifying for impeding Liam Lawson, meaning both Ferrari drivers rose one place.

It could prove significant. Hamilton, like Russell, knows this weekend represents a golden opportunity to close the gap to Kimi Antonelli in the title race. The two Britons are tied second in the championship heading into the weekend, 59 points behind the Italian. But Antonelli, who sacrificed his qualifying to help Russell, must start from the back of the grid on Sunday due to exceeding the permitted number of engines in a season.

Industry observers note that it promises to be a fascinating race, with Antonelli fighting his way through the pack and Russell and Hamilton trying to make hay while they can. Russell sounded confident. “I think they [Alpine] have got a car that’s got some good straight-line speed, which will be nice for them in the race. But, yeah, confident I’ve got the pace to go for the win.”.

Could he be underestimating Gasly again? The Frenchman, who lives locally in Milan and speaks fluent Italian, has won here before. He claimed the only victory of his F1 career at Monza for AlphaTauri in 2020.

Industry observers note that “Anything is possible tomorrow,” insisted Steve Nielsen, Alpine’s managing director. “We didn’t expect to be in pole position, we are. Tomorrow, good starts, good strategy, good pit stops – who knows? Let’s try to win it.”.

Gasly himself said he had no idea what he was capable of. “My strategy is to stay first as long as I can. How long is that going to be? I have no idea. My focus is going to be on my driving and making no mistakes and making the best out of what I have.” Perhaps that will be enough for another checkmate.

Antonelli acknowledged that his engine-parts grid penalty meant he had no reason not to assist his teamate Russell by offering towing assistance.

He seemed a little peeved at times on the radio, but he did his job. With Russell likely to need to return the favour for him later this season, there is no point causing bother.

He told Sky Sports: “It’s what I have to do. The team asked me and of course I did what I had to do, I tried to help as much as possible. It’s a bit weird going in two, even the lap I did alone was a bit of a weird feeling. Overall with the penalty today I had to be a good teammate and I had to help as much as I could. I think I did a good job with that and happy it worked out.”.

Industry observers note that here’s Oscar Piastri, asked if a pole had been possible: “I don’t think so, no. I think the first lap felt good and I tried to see if anyone wanted to go in front out of the pit lane but no one did and I knew it was always going to be difficult and misjudged the braking a little bit and locked up. That was the session but good to have a decent result, it has been a while. I’ll take it.”.

Sources indicate that alpine managing director Steve Nielsen remarked to Sky Sports that they were aiming high: “Pierre is a class act, as you say, if you give him the machine, he will deliver. We failed to do that a few times last year. We haven’t always given him the most competitive machinery this year, but when we have he has delivered. Particularly earlier in the season so to see the team bounce back, to see him deliver on the track he knows well, he lives locally, he lives in Milan. It was wonderful.

Recent findings suggest that “We mustn’t forget Franco either, he’s done a great job today. I really feel we have given them a good car, and who knows? Anything is possible tomorrow.”.

Recent findings suggest that here’s what he mentioned immediately after the session: “Massive congrats to Pierre because that’s an incredible performance. We were actually playing a game of chess about 15 minutes before qualifying and he beat me there and I thought ‘well I think I’ll beat you in qualifying’ and here we are - he’s ahead of me again! I was disappointed not to get pole. It was a bit messy with Verstappen opening the lap. But Pierre and Alpine have been super fast, even from Q1. Happy to see them get a good result.”.

Gasly’s advantage, it appears, seems to be over Russell’s car understeering and lacking grip in turbulent air.

P1 ☝️#F1 #ItalianGP pic.twitter.com/U0hebWsjWY.

According to recent reports, he indicates: “It was amazing, thank you everyone. It was an incredible qualy. I felt very good in the car. I was trying to chip away in evert session. I’m so happy, it’s been nine years trying to get a pole. First win [was] in Monza, to get pole is very special.”.

He then pays credit to his team and the fans in Italian, and I am leaning on my Latin to get the gist of it.

“I was disappointed not to get the pole,” admits Russell who said he had been playing chess with Gasly before the game and the Frenchman won that, with Russell confident he was going to beat him in qualifying.

Sources indicate that alpine been in the news all weekend. Fair to say that pole lap from Gasly is better PR for the team than Flavio Briatore’s bizarre outburst in the FIA press conference yesterday. Well done that man.

His tone is evidently disappointed. In truth, given Hamilton is fifth, he is in a strong position to have the best of the weekend.

Gasly, yes, was fastest, but Russell has been the most consistent.

In a recent development, piastri could be in trouble, too, for impeding earlier in the day’s sesion. Ferrari, in fourth and fifth, do not look entirely competitive.

Russell is second, Piastri third, Leclerc fourth, Hamilton fifth, Verstappen sixth, Antonelli seventh, Colapinto eighth, Norris ninth and Lindblad 10th.

He starts his flying lap, and locks up at turn 1 and exceeds track limits. That means Norris will be unable to get a tow from him too.

After being the quickest at FP2 and FP3, he is top of the pack once more with a bit over five minutes left.

Antonelli has done him a favour there, but Russell may need to return the favour in similar circumstances down the line.

Hamilton is now down in ninth, and struggling, about 0.8s off the pace.

Piastri may be in for some bother.

In a recent development, hamilton needs to catch Leclerc to get a tow. It failed to happen last time out.

Piastri finished Q2 in P2 but it looks likely he'll be penalised for this incident involving Lawson#F1 #ItalianGP pic.twitter.com/RGzzEeqyql.

Lawson, Hulkenberg, Sainz, Ocon, Bearman and Bortoleto are all out.

Hamilton is 10th, one-thousandth of a second quick enough to scrape through, and Leclrec ninth.

“**** me” exclaims Hamilton, without saying, ‘Asterisk’ once.

Antonelli asks for the chance to go out with another team ahead so he can get a tow of his own.

Norris now second quickest, so perhaps those brakes are up to speed.

There is some suggestion that Hamilton might need a front wing change.

The Silver Arrows working in tandem Kimi in front, George slipstreaming behind #F1 #ItalianGP pic.twitter.com/H476E91GJs.

But Gasly is going fastest in his out lap.

Industry observers note that verstappen now goes fastest. Lawson is in behind, with Carlos Sainz making a surprise appearance up top.

Hamilton and Russell are yet to lay down times.

Norris is uncomfortable with his brakes at Monza.

Given he’s well outside of the fastest for now, the pressure is on him to make Q3.

The two Aston Martins are out, along with Yuki Tsunoda, Alex Albon, Valtteri Bottas and Sergio Perez.

Q2 awaits, with Gasly fastest - aiming for what would be his first pole.

In a recent development, alonso, meanwhile, has wirthdrawn from the session. Things going wrong for the veteran, who must have no other hobbies.

FOUR MINUTES TO GO IN Q1TOP 6 ⬆️Gasly VerstappenColapintoAntonelliRussellHamiltonBOTTOM 6 ⬇️Hulkenberg AlbonBottasAlonsoStrollPerez#F1 #ItalianGP pic.twitter.com/BYdYjrjtnu.

Industry observers note that pierre Gasly takes his Alpine for a spin. He is now fastest, with Verstappen second, and Colapinto bookending the Dutchman.

Antonelli and then Russell next, with the stricken Antonelli likely to give his colleague a tow.

The Red Bull man is 0.216s clear of Hamilton, with Piastri just behind.

No surprising stragglers just yet, but 11 minutes to go of this section.

We’ve 16 minutes left, and some cars are finally coming out to do battle.

It has been revealed that 18 minutes ahead before the final two rounds. Nobody is doing anything. As they say in football: tactically fascinating.

Recent findings suggest that monza paddock is absolutely sweltering. 33.8C out here. I just passed Fabio Capello on my way back to the media centre. He was speaking to Sky Sports Italia so I wasn’t able to give him my thoughts on where he went wrong at the 2010 World Cup.

Recent findings suggest that decent ding dong between Hamilton and Verstappen in practice earlier. Hopefully Hamilton is fired up for this. With Antonelli taking his grid drop at his home race, there’s a massive opportunity for both Hamilton and Russell to close the gap this weekend.

The tifosi are ready 🙌It's time for qualifying at the Temple of Speed 👊#F1 #ItalianGP pic.twitter.com/jeiTcb8Ij2.

The cars will soon be out on the track, and we’ll have reports of their progress.

There are actually times when affection for a car firm makes sense, despite what I said earlier.

Sound on... listen to the reception for Charles and Lewis ❤️#F1 #ItalianGP @ScuderiaFerrari pic.twitter.com/kk6BvA1UdC.

As touched on earlier, Lewis Hamilton has to hope Charles Leclerc will work with him.

The Monegasque (look it up) is the junior partner at this point, whether he wants to be or not. That might not make him entirely delighted, but he can tow the British driver around and give him a launch for fast laps, if he’s feeling helpful.

Everyone now has access to PowerPoint, which means we all now have to have, “learnings.”.

Imagine if someone you met in real life mentioned that to you.

3 hours of laps and learnings done.#ItalianGP pic.twitter.com/GTvOvL5L5M.

Given Antonelli is still one of the quickest on the track, it would be no surprise if he can at least make the top 10.

Favourable accidents and yellow flags might offer up more opportunities, too, but both Hamilton and Russell need to strike while they have such a clear advantage.

George Russell tops Lewis Hamilton in final practice in Monza 🇮🇹💪 pic.twitter.com/jxIO13aRX6.

I’m as major a fan of F1 as the next man, assuming the next man quite likes F1, but there is something strange about supporting a car tech giant, isn’t there?

🇮🇹 Sentendo il calore dell'Italia! 🥰🇬🇧 Feeling the warmth of Italy! 🥰 pic.twitter.com/ze6Ww1Z0zx.

The session starts in around 40 minutes, so drivers are on their Gameboys and Instagram, and reading the weekend edition of The Telegraph.

Words we live by, this weekend and always ❤️ pic.twitter.com/0QoGlpzOHI.

Here’s our interview with Alex Albon about a grim weekend at Monza.

In a recent development, “Alex Albon remembers the 2022 Italian Grand Prix well. He had been looking forward to it. ‘We had a car which was good down the straights that year so I was quite excited to be going to Monza,” the Williams driver recalls, a little wistfully.

‘We did FP1 and FP2 and sure enough we were quick so I was like: ‘This is going to be a good weekend.’.

“Albon could not have been more wrong. He remembers waking at around 1am that night and being unable to get back to sleep.

“What happened next was the stuff of nightmares. Albon called the doctor, was diagnosed with appendicitis, sent to San Gerardo Hospital in Monza for surgery, only to suffer an unexpected complication during the procedure, which resulted in acute respiratory failure.”.

He shares the joint record with Michael Schumacher for most wins at Monza.

According to recent reports, schumacher, a Ferrari legend, ended his career with five. Hamilton has the same.

Sport loves an emotional link to records, so be prepared for this to become a substantial moment.

Five wins apiece for Michael and Lewis 🖐#F1 #ItalianGP pic.twitter.com/j10lMygYft.

The Italian team are bringing an upgrade engine to Monza for the weekend.

Hamilton would desperately love to go out at the top after what is a remarkable return to decent form after some years of desperate struggle.

With Antonelli possibly out of the running this weekend, this is the chance to change the - *spits in self-scorn* - narrative.

Russell might have incurred a penalty if he had done this in qualifying.

The Mercedes man blocked Oscar Piastri’s run at a corner, forcing some heavy braking from his rival.

Thankfully, Piastri ducked out, and thankfully for Russell, he’s not facing censure.

Recent findings suggest that A near miss for Oscar Piastri! 😬 pic.twitter.com/y6UMu8wIDM.

The pair are just natural friends.

Max Verstappen and Lewis Hamilton go racing! 🍿 pic.twitter.com/Zs8u8h4XoT.

The former world champion is still looking for more from his car.

“Just looking at the deltas there, I was losing something like 0.6secs to George on the straights, which is something we need to look into,” Hamilton said yesterday, before explaining his conundrum for qualifying, suggesting he may go out after Leclerc.

“The tow is everything here so [I’m] likely to be looking for the tow.”.

Because Antonelli exceeded the limit of parts used for his engine, he is taking a grid penalty at Monza.

Few would entirely rule out a storming ride for him on Sunday to end up top of the pack, but is is clearly a huge task for him to score points of any kind with that disadvantage.

They are now likely both past their peaks, but Hamilton and Verstappen recalled their battles of 2021 when they clashed in practice earlier.

Verstappen was already hacked off with Hamilton for seemingly obstructing his path earlier in the session, and they almost came together in the dying moments of the session.

Hamilton needed to take the escape road at the first chicane, where the pair made contact in 2021, as Verstappen looked to slip around his occasional rival. The two of them scarcely avoided another contact.

On the radios, Verstappen claimed, “He caused that,” while Hamilton reported to Ferrari that he was, “Blocked by Max.” Perhaps there will be more aggro later.

The full list of times from earlier today.

FP3 CLASSIFICATIONRussell in the box seat heading into qualifying#F1 #ItalianGP pic.twitter.com/BUrCsv92dT.

Welcome to Telegraph Sport’s live coverage of and qualifying for the Monza Grand Prix.

Before the weekend’s racing, George Russell was, at least publicly, less than bullish about his chances in Italy.

He did, though, believe he would deliver a better showing than he had in recent weeks.

“I don’t know if we can say we’re favourites this weekend, but we probably have a greater opportunity than we’ve had in the last two races where it’s been less about the power unit and more about the chassis,” he said.

“It’s so close right now, that last tenth in qualifying can be the difference of a couple of positions, which can change the podium. Right now, I don’t know who is going to be the team to beat.”.

Industry observers note that russell was almost a minute off winner Lando Norris of McLaren in Hungary, finishing seventh in his Mercedes. Two weeks ago, in the Netherlands, he took the last spot on the podium, with Norris winning again.

However, in the second practice session on Friday and FP3 today, Russell was quickest. He led his former colleague, Ferrari’s Lewis Hamilton, who was second fastest.

Red Bull’s Max Verstappen hinted at a rare good weekend as he was third fastest, about a third of a second behind Russell.

Russell, of course, needs a win soon, or he is in danger of seeing the championship run away from him entirely, as Kimi Antonelli already leads him by 59 points in the world title chase.

Industry observers note that perhaps psychologically just as pressing is that erstwhile teammate Hamilton is tied with Russell on 183 points, in third because he has one victory compared to Russell’s two. Slipping down the rankings could knock his confidence.

Russell has not secured pole for the last four races, so a strong showing in qualifying might be the boost he needs ahead of Sunday’s race, while Norris is looking for a pole position hat-trick.

Les All Blacks c'est l'ambiance de Geoffroy-Guichard

À l’occasion du podcast Montpellier Sport Club, disponible en vidéo et en audio depuis ce jeudi 19 novembre sur le site du journal Midi Libre, l’entraîneur du MHSC Zoumana Camara a raconté comment il avait puisé dans ses souvenirs d’un haka des All Blacks et la réaction du XV de France pour préparer le déplacement de son équipe à Saint-Étienne.

It has been revealed that "Je me nourris de tout." Comme de nombreux entraîneurs, Zoumana Camara aime aller puiser dans d’autres sports pour nourrir sa méthode. Amateur de basket-ball NBA, de handball ou d’athlétisme, dont il admire le fait de se "préparer pour une compétition qui dure 1’30, un saut, dix secondes", le coach du MHSC regarde également du côté du rugby international. Une source ovale au sein de laquelle il a récemment déniché une inspiration.

"Quand on a préparé Saint-Étienne et qu’on est allés jouer là-bas (le 5 septembre), je sais que j’ai une jeune équipe, qu’on va jouer à Geoffroy-Guichard où l’ambiance est un douzième homme. Alors j’ai voulu faire une causerie un peu différente. Elle m’est venue le matin (du match). Je me suis souvenu que lorsque j’étais plus jeune, j’avais aimé la France lorsqu’elle avait affronté les All Blacks, face à face au moment du haka (en 2007). Et je voulais montrer à mes joueurs que l’environnement, il faut l’affronter de face avant que le match commence et leur dire que les All Blacks, ce sera l’ambiance de Geoffroy-Guichard", détaille-t-il.

Recent findings suggest that À cette comparaison s’est également ajouté un changement d’habitude. "Pour la première fois, j’ai dit au staff d’aller faire l’échauffement à côté du Kop (des Verts). Et pas en plein milieu, pour ne pas fuir", explique Zoumana Camara.

Le Patriote, édition Beaujolais Val de Saône, aussitôt la victoire des Verts acquise à Rumilly, signifiant un ASSE-FCVB pour le 8ème tour de la Coupe de France, est revenu 16 ans en arrière. Il fait un flash-back sur cette rencontre du 3 février 2010, qui avait vu les Verts l'emporter péniblement sur les Caladois (2-2 ap pro, 1-3 aux tab) en 16ème de finale de cette même Coupe de France.

In a recent development, "L'histoire qui recommence. Seize ans ont passés, depuis la dernière fête du FCVB en Coupe de France, et la venue de l'AS Saint-Etienne à Armand-Chouffet pour le compte des 16es-de-finale d'une épreuve qui avait attiré plus de 3000 personnes en Calade, comme on se donne rendez-vous pour un événement majeur dans une vie de football.Cela avait été une douleur infinie et mémorable pour le groupe du coach Jean-Michel Picollet – lui-même cœur stéphanois – mais les coéquipiers du portier si constant, Franck Laurent, s'étaient construits des souvenirs pour toute une vie. La leur. Et aujourd'hui, ce sont leurs héritiers, plus à la peine en Ligue 3, qui ont gagné le droit de défier l'ASSE, ce gros bras de la Ligue 2, dans moins de quinze jours au stade mythique de Geoffroy-Guichard.".

Pour rappel, l'ASSE alignait la composition suivante : Planté - Dos Reis, Diakhité, Monsoreau, N'Daw - Matuidi, Guilavogui, Mirallas (Payet, 72ème) - Bergessio (Rivière, 94ème)., Sanogo, SakoButs : Bergessio (10ème), Sako (85ème)Tirs au but : Sanogo, Rivière, Payet (seuls 3 tirs au but avaient été nécessaires).

Brajan Gruda scored two goals and provided two assists in his first two appearances for the German national team against Serbia and the Netherlands over the recent international break and with four assists in seven Bundesliga games for RB Leipzig in 2026/27, the 22-year-old’s stock continues to rise.

Industry observers note that on loan from Premier League side Brighton and Hove Albion, Gruda’s move to Leipzig will become permanent in the fresh year if he plays every match between now and Hoffenheim on 16 January. The fee: €25m. The newly capped German international will then pen a contract until July 2031, without a release clause.

According to recent reports, that ultimately means that Leipzig can command any fee they wish for their rising star. With interest from Liverpool and Bayern Munich, and with no intention of selling, BILD estimate Leipzig’s valuation of Gruda to be around €100m.

With impressive numbers across his first two Germany appearances, Gruda was naturally one of seven winners in Jürgen Klopp’s November squad.

Sources indicate that dans Le Patriote, édition Beaujolais Val de Saône, Philippe Terrier, le Président du FC Villefranche Beaujolais qui va affronter l'ASSE pour le compte du 8ème tour de la Coupe de France le samedi 28 novembre à 20 h, se dit partagé entre joie et soulagement de ne pas avoir à gérer l'organisation d'une telle affiche. Le chef de file du FCVB a résumé le sentiment du jour que beaucoup de Caladois devraient partager dans les jours à venir :.

"C'est un vrai bonheur pour nous tous ! On s'attend à un match compliqué mais on ne veut pas que l'histoire s'arrête là. On va vivre quelque chose d'extraordinaire, après avoir découvert le Groupama Stadium face au PSG, en 2019, on va connaître Geoffroy-Guichard ! C'est extraordinaire pour le FCVB.".

According to recent reports, une affiche qui convoque quelques souvenirs, en Calade. L'un des plus drôles concerne aussi Philippe Terrier, puisque c'est lors de la venue de Saint-Etienne en 2010 à Villefranche, que l'actuel président du FCVB avait sauté dans le bain de ses actuelles responsabilités pour prendre un poste que l'un de ses illustres prédécesseurs, Jean Gachon avait si bien occupé, des années durant" précise Le Patriote.

In a recent development, this was the definition of a hard-earned point. Newcastle United came back from two goals down to rescue a point against Bournemouth, but this was not a convincing performance from Matthias Jaissle’s side.

Sources indicate that newcastle were abject for the first half an hour and the visitors could have been out of sight. It was disjointed and lacklustre as Bournemouth dominated before the break and regularly threatened Lukasz Hornicek in goal.

According to recent reports, even during the fightback, Newcastle lacked cohesion and penetration, but forced their way back into it through hard work, spirit and determination. Whether you believe Harvey Barnes’ wonder goal and Jacob Ramsey’s late strike paper over the cracks or reveal a togetherness – a grit and determination that bodes well for the future – depends on the individual.
